## Migrator.available() method

Migration names on disk, in the order they should be applied.

**Signature:**

```typescript
available(): Promise<string[]>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;string\[\]&gt;

Filenames without extension, sorted lexically — which is chronological, given the timestamp prefix convention.

## Remarks

Reads `.ts`<!-- -->, `.mts`<!-- -->, `.js` and `.mjs` files, ignoring declaration files. A missing directory yields an empty list rather than an error, so a project without migrations yet still runs.
